name: 33169 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33169 (Miami) has 255 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33169 (Miami) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33169 (Miami) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 74% of all organizations here have no identified type.
